2607.17281.title: AIGB-R1: Self-Evolving Generative Auto-Bidding via Hierarchical Planner-Executor Optimization
2607.17281.paper_summary: Auto-bidding plays an essential role in online advertising, automatically adjusting bids for advertisers to optimize their commercial goals. The emerging AI-Generated Bidding (AIGB) paradigm widely adopts generative modeling to optimize bidding strategies, yet suffers from the limited mode coverage of offline datasets and inadequate task-state understanding, hindering effective exploration of optimal strategies. Large Language Models (LLMs), with prior world knowledge and reasoning capabilities, offer a promising approach to overcome these limitations. However, directly applying LLMs to auto-bidding tasks faces inherent challenges in limited numerical precision, hallucinations, and inference latency. To address these limitations, we propose AIGB-R1, a hierarchical self-evolving auto-bidding framework aiming to enhance AI-Generated Bidding via LLMs' Reasoning capabilities, comprising a high-level Planner module for macro-level strategy planning and a low-level Executor module for fine-grained decision-making. Building upon this, we design an experience-driven self-evolving loop, enabling autonomous strategy exploration and optimization from accumulated experience. We adopt a two-stage pipeline of offline pre-training and post-training alignment, and build an interactive bidding simulation environment for strategy rollout. Furthermore, we propose Decoupled Group Relative Policy Optimization (D-GRPO) to achieve end-to-end optimization via advantage decoupling. Experimental results on a large-scale public dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of AIGB-R1.
2607.17281.paper_summary_zh: 自動出價在網路廣告中扮演著重要角色，能夠自動調整廣告主的出價以優化其商業目標。新興的AI生成出價（AIGB）範式廣泛採用生成建模來優化出價策略，但受到離線數據集的模式覆蓋有限和任務狀態理解不足的影響，妨礙了有效探索最佳策略。大型語言模型（LLMs）具備先前的世界知識和推理能力，提供了一種有前景的方法來克服這些限制。然而，直接將LLMs應用於自動出價任務面臨著有限數值精度、幻覺和推理延遲等固有挑戰。為了解決這些限制，我們提出了AIGB-R1，一個層次化自我演化的自動出價框架，旨在通過LLMs的推理能力增強AI生成出價，包含一個高階規劃者模塊用於宏觀策略規劃，以及一個低階執行者模塊用於細緻的決策制定。在此基礎上，我們設計了一個經驗驅動的自我演化循環，使得能夠從累積的經驗中自主探索和優化策略。我們採用離線預訓練和後訓練對齊的兩階段管道，並建立了一個互動出價模擬環境以進行策略推廣。此外，我們提出了解耦群體相對政策優化（D-GRPO），通過優勢解耦實現端到端優化。在大規模公共數據集上的實驗結果顯示了AIGB-R1的有效性。
